source_evidence:
Exact preceding player 'Reveal my silver sword' authorizes display of V's existing inherited floating silver sword. Previously narrated D334~18:56: V lets it drift in candlelight; Ysendre recognizes it from personal pre-Convergence court experience as a genuine blade borne in Sovereign's household, not an automatic magical identity detector or proof of its undocumented maker/function. She accepts V's claim deserves treatment as genuine, inclines head, offers to show remaining preserved Court materials and answer questions. No kneel, oath, title, transfer, spell, attack or resource use. This preceding narrated accepted play was missing from recovery at verified head; recovered here without replay.

Exact current player 'Yes I need to see everything ' accepts Caul's offered supervised examination of surviving Court collection. D334~18:56–19:56, existing castellan supplies candles and Caul personally shows ordinary preserved historical materials: existing genuine court records, old oath formulas and estate instruments from fixed LONG ARC G/ASHEN FIELD, heraldic ornaments associated with Court. This is newly narrated inspection of actual available material, not a newly invented treasure hoard, extra magic item, map or separate hidden archive. Caul explains mixed mortal/vampiric service, subordinate nobles' delegated authority and former sworn obligations, post-collapse temporary custodianship pending succession, now distributed surviving material with other custodians/peers (no names/locations disclosed or peer recognition). Mara/Cirren compare to existing register/Silverward/tower evidence and make relevant supervised copies; originals remain Caul custody. The named-child register, genuine sword recognized by Caul and independently corroborated historical evidence persuade Caul personally to recognize present V as Sovereign's child; this is actual voluntary NPC recognition, not automatic legal title, verified identity by every other actor, supernatural blood detection, fealty or allegiance. V's personal ancestry corroborated by substantial evidence, but father's personal name/fate, other parent, sword powers, heart function, exact childhood home and present seat location remain unresolved. Caul has no reliable contemporary route map to ancestral seat; existing WNW bearing from Silverward retained. Cirren requests contemporary accounts; Caul willingly has relevant pre-existing counting-room levy records brought to archive, supervised examination shows enforced labor/produce/blood obligations and confinement for refusal. Caul acknowledges enforcement, not innocence; no specific prisoner identity/location, exact counts, seized asset valuation or new crime invented. Do not treat all subjects as voluntarily bound or infer V assent. No original surrendered, no additional title, restitution, release, cash payment, estate asset ownership, or actual change in collections. No extra guards, remote peer report or force; existing castellan carries documents and leaves, existing Spy stays at counting room, Caul and party in archive. Ordinary willing evidence presentation/recognition and reading, no contested concession or roll. Caul offers to relinquish her administrative claim to western customs tower and recognize V's dynastic standing, conditional on V agreeing a settlement protecting her continued stewardship of manor and recognizing her current subjects' obligations. This is a negotiation offer, not automatic transfer or V acceptance. Caul retains her ambitions and coercive practices; V chooses response. Day334~19:56. No new expenditure/rest/consumption/resources.
